name: slider
title: Slider
description: The prediction slider. It snaps to a configurable interval, five by default, so a prediction of 47 and a prediction of 48 are the same prediction and no host has to bucket them afterwards. Moving it is not answering with it: a moved thumb is `data-gs-selected`, picked and reversible, and a separate commit control makes it `data-gs-committed`. The track is inset and the thumb is raised, which is the one rule that tells a player where to type from where to press. Keyboard-operable by the increment, with Home and End, and `data-gs-value` carrying the machine-readable number alongside whatever is rendered. Performs nothing: it does not score the prediction, settle it or send it anywhere.
docs: Pass `label` to name the thing being predicted; a slider with no name is unusable with a screen reader. Pass `increment` to change the snap interval, which is five per BDS-014. `commits` defaults to `"separate"`, which renders the commit control and is what a prediction wants; `"immediate"` is for the rare surface where the drag itself is the answer, a volume rather than a prediction. Take the answer from `onCommitted`, never from `onValueChange`: the second one fires for every number the player passes through on the way. Pass `value` to own the number yourself, or `defaultValue` to let the slider hold it; either way it is snapped before it is rendered.
